description: This file defines types and functions related to Tlon accounts configuration and resolution within the openclaw plugin SDK, including account merging, resolution, and listing account IDs.

methods.name: resolveTlonChannelConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Tlon channel configuration from the OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: resolveMergedTlonAccountConfig
methods.description: Merges the channel configuration with account-specific overrides, returning a comprehensive account config.

methods.name: resolveTlonAccount
methods.description: Resolves and returns a detailed Tlon account object based on the configuration and account ID.

methods.name: listTlonAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all Tlon account IDs configured within the given OpenClawConfig.
